text: The initiative has completed in-country support for the 2020 Enhanced NDC review, conducted a gap analysis of adaptation policies, finalized quantifiable adaptation targets, and strengthened frameworks for land use governance, reporting, and monitoring. The NDC Implementation Plan is prepared and updated annually, with active preparation for NDC 3.0 and BTR1 by 2025.
